theorems.name: Submission.dgc_pm_vitali_volume_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ) (R M : ℝ), (∀ b ∈ S, 0 < r b ∧ r b ≤ R) → (∀ u ⊆ S, u.PairwiseDisjoint (fun b => closedBall b (r b)) → u.Countable ∧ ∑' b : u, ENNReal.ofReal (r b ^ Fintype.card ι) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M) → volume S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (10 ^ Fintype.card ι * M)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
